corrected_pricing._scope: prices the baseline-completion session only; it does not re-price Search-1

generalizable_lesson: a single observation of a variable quantity is not a bound, and a stage-to-stage wall-clock slice is not a proxy for work that slice did not execute. Price a derivation in the unit it is performed in -- here, evaluations -- and divide by the slowest rate observed rather than multiplying an average duration.
